# Gelabber v0.11.0

Integrated through #588 to #594 (#574, #575), #597 (#563), #598 (#565),
#599 (#581), #600 (#566), #601 (#570), #602 (#590) and #605 (#604) into
`v0.11`, and the version PR into `main`.

A feature release for people, pictures and presence. **Friends** with
friend codes and **message requests** decide who can open a DM, and you can
**block** a person. **Pictures** get thumbnails, a mosaic, a gallery viewer,
alt text and stripped location data. You can set **Away, Do not disturb or
Invisible** by hand, and the app no longer shows you as Away while you are
there. **The upgrade runs five database migrations (0037 to 0041): take a
backup first, because going back to v0.10.2 is only possible by restoring
it.** `.env` needs no edit.

## Friends and message requests (#563)

- **Friend codes.** Every account has a code like `ABCD-EF23` under
  Friends (web `/d/friends`, and in the desktop app's sidebar). Add someone
  by code, accept or decline requests, and regenerate your own code.
- **Who can open a DM.** Friends open an ordinary DM. People who share a
  server start a **message request**: up to 3 text-only messages (no links,
  mentions, files or GIFs) until the recipient accepts. Strangers can only
  send a friend request. Every DM from before this release counts as
  accepted.
- Declining a message request is silent and final; the sender's view stays
  like an unanswered request. Declining a friend request removes it, and a
  new one is possible after an hour.
- The data export now includes your friend code, friends and pending
  friend requests.

## Blocking (#565)

- "Blockieren" on profile cards and on an incoming message request. While a
  block stands, DMs, message requests and friend requests are closed in
  both directions, and the blocked person's pushes, mentions (including
  @everyone), typing and notifications don't reach you.
- Blocking ends a friendship and declines that person's pending message
  request. Unblocking keeps an accepted DM usable but does not restore the
  friendship.
- On shared servers, runs of their messages fold into "N blockierte
  Nachrichten · Anzeigen". Settings has a new "Blockiert" page with
  everyone you block.
- The blocked person is never told "blocked", but in an existing DM they see
  that they can no longer write there.

## Pictures (#574, #575)

- **Thumbnails.** The server stores each picture's size and makes 400 and
  800 px thumbnails, so chat lists load far less data and don't jump while
  pictures load. Pictures already stored are filled in by a background
  worker after the upgrade (see the upgrade notes).
- **Privacy.** New uploads lose their location and other metadata (EXIF
  except the orientation, XMP, IPTC, comments, and motion-photo video
  appended to JPEGs). Pictures uploaded before this release are not
  rewritten.
- **Display.** One picture keeps its own shape (up to 400×400). Several
  pictures form a mosaic with "+N" past six. Animated GIFs up to 5 MiB play
  inline, larger ones show a "GIF" badge.
- **Gallery viewer** in the browser and the desktop app: step through all
  pictures of a message, zoom with the wheel, pinch or double tap, pan, and
  close with Esc, swipe down or the back button.
- **Phones:** the paperclip offers "Fotos & Videos", "Kamera" and "Datei".
  The browser shows upload progress on the picture. HEIC/HEIF files are
  accepted as downloads.
- **Alt text.** Each picture can carry a description of up to 1,000
  characters, written in the composer ("ALT") or added later on your own
  sent pictures. It is shown in an "ALT" badge and in the viewer, and screen
  readers read it. Changing only the alt text does not mark the message as
  edited.

## Presence (#566, #590)

- **Manual status** in the account menu: Automatic (default), Away, Do not
  disturb and Invisible, for 1 h, 8 h, 24 h or until changed.
  - **Do not disturb**: others see a red dot; no Web Push, sounds, toasts or
    system notifications until it ends. Badges still count.
  - **Invisible**: others see you offline and your typing is not sent.
    Voice channels still list you.
- **No more false "Away".** The desktop app showed everyone as Away five
  minutes after start. It now counts input anywhere on the computer
  (Windows, Wayland with ext-idle-notify-v1, X11, older GNOME). In a voice
  channel and not deafened you stay Online on every client, also when you
  leave the computer; deafen or leave the call to go Away after 5 minutes.

## Account menu and audio settings (#570)

- One menu on your avatar: status, Edit profile, Give feedback, Operator,
  Switch server (desktop) and Sign out. The gear always opens Settings, also
  during a call.
- Audio settings live in one place, Settings → Audio, with the diagnostics
  at its end. The voice settings dialog is gone; the quick popover in the
  voice room links to "Alle Audio-Einstellungen →".

## GIFs (#581)

- GIFs picked from KLIPY search results could not be sent ("Saving the
  message failed"), because search results now carry a per-search token in
  the slug. The API now matches on the base slug.
- A failed send now says why, for example "This GIF is no longer
  available." or "Too many messages. Try again in N seconds."

## Upgrade notes

- **Back up first** (`deploy/backup.sh`, see `deploy/README.md` "Backup"),
  or pause Watchtower before this release is published.
- **Five migrations, none reversible without the backup:**
  - `0037_attachment_pictures`: picture sizes, placeholder, thumbnail and
    media worker columns on `attachments`; the delete trigger also removes
    thumbnails.
  - `0038_attachment_descriptions`: `attachments.description` (alt text).
  - `0039_friends`: friend codes, `friendships`, `friend_requests`, and
    message request columns on DM channels.
  - `0040_user_blocks`: `user_blocks`.
  - `0041_presence_mode`: `users.presence_mode` and `presence_mode_until`.
- **Background work after the first start:** the media worker goes through
  every existing JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP attachment, newest first, one at a
  time, and writes two thumbnails per picture to MinIO
  (`<key>/t400`, `<key>/t800`). Expect some CPU use and storage growth until
  it is done. Until a picture has thumbnails, clients get the original.
- **No new `.env` variable**, no changed setting. The image pins
  `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to `v0.11.0`.
- **Rollback:** only by restoring the backup together with the v0.10.2
  image set.
- **Order:** server first, then clients. Older clients keep working against
  a v0.11.0 server, but they don't show friends, message requests, blocks
  or the manual status; they see Do not disturb as Online. Strangers get
  `403 dm_not_allowed` when they try to open a DM. New clients work against
  older servers without the new features.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

## CI and repository

- **Project board automation** (#604, #605): issue cards move between
  Backlog, Planned, In progress, In review and Done when issues are
  assigned and PRs open, change state or merge; a merge into a version
  branch also closes the issue. It needs the repository secret
  `PROJECT_TOKEN` (a fine-grained token with org Projects read and write).
  Without it the runs only warn, and closing issues still works.
- New API tests for pictures, alt text, friends, blocks and presence
  modes, and parity scenes updated for the account menu and Settings →
  Audio.

## Open

- None of this was tested on real devices: the Android photo picker, iOS
  camera and HEIC, swipe and pinch, the idle detection on Windows, Wayland
  and X11, and alt text with Orca or VoiceOver.
- After the deploy: send a GIF from search on gelabber.com once by hand
  (#581).
- KLIPY's terms for server-side GIF requests on the hosted instance (#556).
- The rejected-file note in the composer never goes away (#603), a bug
  from before this release.
